title: A look at iLands, a company that's like Fiverr for agents, which email annoying and unsolicited pitches to people, usually for services costing ~$25 (Ernie Smith/Tedium)
summary: Ernie Smith / Tedium: A look at iLands, a company that's like Fiverr for agents, which email annoying and unsolicited pitches to people, usually for services costing ~$25 — Making sense of iLands, the company whose AI agents emailed me half a dozen times in two days offering to do my research.
